name: ECC
description: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
one_liner: A toolkit that makes AI coding assistants like Claude Code remember more, work more safely, and perform better by adding memory, security guardrails, and learned habits.
buyer: An engineering manager at a company that just adopted Claude Code or Codex and is worried about inconsistent output and security slip-ups across the team.
business_use_cases: A dev team installs the GitHub App on private repos to get enforced security scanning and memory continuity on every AI-assisted pull request.
An agency reselling 'AI-assisted development' services installs ECC Pro to standardize quality and security across every client project.
A platform engineering team uses the hardening and security layer to pass internal compliance review before letting AI agents touch production code.

money_ideas.idea: The project already sells ECC Pro seats for private-repo use via its GitHub App.
Offer paid onboarding and configuration services for enterprises rolling this out company-wide.

steal_this: It's infrastructure for developers, not a product for non-coders; install it on your own team's repos and, if it works, resell the setup as a service to other small dev shops.
